text: How to act on a first date if you want a second one. Guys, I haven't answered your questions for a while, so it's time to do it. Hey man, how are you? I admire your videos a lot and thank you for providing such valuable information to all the men out there. I thought my experience and a question would be really common for your community, so here it is. I recently went out with a girl on a date, which wasn't really a date at the end. She did nothing wrong. She maintained eye contact, spoke a lot, asked me questions, started talking whenever the silence went too long. Me, on the contrary, I couldn't find words to talk and was an AFK person in real life. Now I realize what I should have done. I had to be more tactile and initiate more physical contacts, be more flirty in my speech. At least I think so. I didn't even hug her at the end, she just gave me a high five. Anyway, she doesn't seem to be interested in me anymore. But still, how should I act on a first date to ensure the successful continuation of the relationships onto the next stage? Thank you for your response and best regards. Okay guys, first, it is okay to be nervous before or during the first date. The trick is not to overcomplicate it. Realize this, if the girl shows up to the date, you are already in a good position. She probably had other guys texting her and other things to do, but she chose to spend her evening with you. That means she is most probably interested. So don't treat the date like an exam you have to pass. The number one goal is simple. Have a good time, bring good energy, relax, enjoy yourself. When you are having fun, she feels it too. Number two, see it as an experience. Every date teaches you something. How to talk, how to find topics, how to handle pauses. Even if it doesn't go anywhere, you still walk away more experience than before. And going back to point number one, you hopefully had a good time. And only at third place comes the result. If it leads to another date, kisses, or more, great. If not, that is fine too. You just move on. That said, having a good time doesn't mean doing nothing. You are at a date, so you probably like the girl. And the girl probably likes you. So you should still act right, flirt, and try to be effective if you wanted to move to the next stage. So number one thing on a date is to make sure that the lady feels comfortable. If she's relaxed, the vibe is good, you are talking about different things and having a good time, then you can try something more. You can try light touching, maybe holding hands. And if you see that she's still comfortable and she reciprocates your signals, you can go for a kiss. Again, be respectful. If it worked, great. If it didn't, it is also fine. Just play it on. Say something like, the way you were looking at me, I figured if I didn't kiss you, you would be upset. With more experience, you would feel those moments better. Bottom line, have fun yourself, make sure the lady is comfortable and relaxed. If you feel you have a green light, act. If not, you don't have to push it. You can still ask her out on a second date, and if she agrees, that is your chance.
